name: 3445-43 (Abu Tig Marina)1B
headline: Minimal & Central 1BDR Apt. @ Abu Tig Marina
summary: This minimal 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's popular Abu Tig Marina and is managed by Xuru Stays

description.Space:
This neat 1 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's Abu Tig Marina. 

The apartment is on the third floor and features an open plan fully equipped kitchen, 1bathroom and a living room with a sofa bed at the bedroom that can sleep up to 2 additional guests. 

It also features a 55 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. The apartment is great for couples & small families. 

The apartment is very central, quiet and minimal, however it is fully equipped to comfortably accommodate guests. 

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
-Marina El Gouna is a central scene with lots of restaurants, bars and shops. 
-'On Time' supermarket is right in front of the residence towards the Marina.
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna.
description.Notes: Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

agreement:
• Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Positive:
Das Zimmer liegt sehr gut an der Abu Tig Marina. Der Eingang zu Treppenaufgang/Fahrstuhl ist gleich rechts neben der kleinen Ladenzeile mit dem Leather Palace, gegenüber vom Kinderspielplatz. Vieles in der Wohnung ist 2024 anscheinend erneuert worden (Küche, Bäder). Die Wohnung, eins der Bäder und die Balkone sind groß. Es wurde an nette Details gedacht wie üppige USB-Steckdosen.

Negative:
Der Check-In-Prozess klappte überhaupt nicht (ich kam allerdings ca. Mitternacht an): Widersprüchliche Informationen von drei verschiedenen WhatsApp-Nummern, ob nun jemand vor Ort empfangen würde oder ob ich einen Schlüsselbox-Code zugesandt bekommen werde. Die Wegbeschreibung über Google Maps führte (vermeidbar) in die Irre (das hat offenbar noch niemand von denen selbst getestet). Als ich das am nächsten Morgen kritisierte, hatte ich nicht den Eindruck, dass man es ändern wird. Die zweite (kleinere) Dusche hat einen Baufehler (Wasser läuft nicht ab). Türblätter (rund um die Klinken) und Schrankgriffe in der Küche könnten mal eine Reinigung vertragen.

One of the best places I’ve stayed! Xuru has an amazing team and Manar was exceptional. Thank you for making the experience so enjoyable. I would definitely love to stay here again!

The property is located in one of Gouna’s prime locations, right at the heart of the marina so it was easily accessible to go anywhere at anytime without compromising it’s privacy & quietness at night.

The apartment itself is very comfortable, neat & well maintained. It actually has 1.5 bathrooms so it did accommodate 3 guests well. 

The elevator was also a great perk considering the property was on the third floor. Property appliances are all new and we faced no issues with them.

10/10 stay would definitely recommend—only thing I would suggest is to get your Gouna QR passes a day or two earlier from the host as we had a bit of an issue with them & had to remain by the gates for a while as it gets resolved.
